title: "Metas"

```{=html}

<div class="tf-page-header"><div><h1>Metas de ahorro</h1><div class="tf-muted">Objetivos vinculables a una cuenta o con avance manual.</div></div><button class="tf-btn tf-btn-secondary" data-logout>Cerrar sesión</button></div><div class="tf-card"><form id="goal-form" class="tf-form-grid"><div class="tf-field"><label>Meta</label><input id="goal-name" required></div><div class="tf-field"><label>Objetivo ($)</label><input id="goal-target" type="number" min="0" step="0.01" required></div><div class="tf-field"><label>Fecha objetivo</label><input id="goal-date" type="date"></div><div class="tf-field"><label>Cuenta vinculada</label><select id="goal-account"></select></div><div class="tf-field"><label>Acumulado manual ($)</label><input id="goal-saved" type="number" min="0" step="0.01" value="0"></div><div class="tf-field" style="display:flex;align-items:end"><button class="tf-btn tf-btn-primary">Guardar meta</button></div></form></div><div id="goal-list" class="tf-grid tf-grid-3" style="margin-top:1rem"></div>


<script type="module" src="js/goals.js"></script>
```
